question: Should ClawHub supersede the prior fixed MIT-0 policy and support declared standard MIT licenses when root package.json or LICENSE metadata says MIT?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but it changes the legal/product contract for published skills and conflicts with prior maintainer direction; automation cannot choose that policy.

options.title: Reaffirm fixed MIT-0 policy
options.body: Close or supersede this PR and resolve the linked mismatch through documentation, publisher consent, or package remediation unless maintainers intentionally reverse the existing policy.

options.title: Approve narrowed MIT support
options.body: Continue with this PR after requiring real runtime proof, rollout/backfill evidence, and any needed spec update for the new stored-license contract.

options.title: Pause for legal review
options.body: Leave the PR and linked issue open until maintainers decide obligations for already-published packages that declare MIT upstream.

recommendation.title: Reaffirm fixed MIT-0 policy
recommendation.body: Close or supersede this PR and resolve the linked mismatch through documentation, publisher consent, or package remediation unless maintainers intentionally reverse the existing policy.
